remarks: Enjoy all that Glenbrook has at Glenbrook Flats where you are within walking distance to the train, restaurants and other local hotspots! Easily entertain guests in your open kitchen, dining area and living room with hardwood floors. The spacious bedroom is fitted with a large closet and wall unit air conditioner.   This unit is available immediately, required to move in is 1 month security + 1st month's rent. Heat and hot water is $50 charge/month tenant is responsible for electric. Assigned parking off street for 1 car is available for additional $75/month. On-site coin operated laundry. Additional storage available in basement for $15/month. TENANT TO PROVIDE COMPLETE APPLICATION INCLUDING BACKGROUND/CREDIT CHECK, PROOF OF INCOME AND REFERENCES. 1 YEAR LEASE REQUIRED.
